headline: Digital Marketing Manager | Marketplace & Performance Growth Specialist
summary: Results-driven Digital Marketing Manager with 6+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance optimization, and team leadership across MENA and EU markets. Proven track record in managing high-volume marketplaces, optimizing full-funnel KPIs (ROAS, conversion rates), and leading cross-functional content and design teams. Expert in leveraging Google Analytics, Meta Ads, and SEO strategies to drive user acquisition and retention. Adept at data-driven decision-making, stakeholder collaboration, and delivering actionable insights to maximize business objectives.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Managed and optimized marketplace performance for a high-traffic financial platform, driving significant growth in user engagement and transaction volume across MENA and EU regions.
Led the Performance Marketing team and coordinated with designers to execute multi-channel campaigns, achieving a 30% improvement in ROAS through rigorous A/B testing and budget reallocation.
Developed and monitored comprehensive SEO strategies, resulting in a 45% increase in organic traffic and improved search visibility for key service pages.
Oversaw social media presence and content strategy, managing a team of copywriters and designers to produce high-quality, engaging assets that aligned with brand objectives.
Utilized Google Analytics and server-side tracking to analyze digital marketing data, identifying trends and providing actionable insights that informed quarterly business planning.
Prepared and presented weekly and monthly performance reports to senior stakeholders, highlighting key KPIs, funnel bottlenecks, and recommended optimizations.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Supported user growth and engagement for a global crypto exchange, managing community channels across Telegram and Discord with a focus on MENA and Asian markets.
Executed AMA campaigns and KOL relations, driving brand awareness and user acquisition through targeted digital marketing initiatives.
Collaborated with product and engineering teams to align marketing efforts with platform features, ensuring a seamless user experience and high retention rates.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Marketing Manager position at Aqarmap Egypt. With over six years of experience in digital marketing and team leadership, I have successfully managed marketplace performance, optimized media buying, and driven organic growth through SEO. My background in leading cross-functional teams and leveraging data from Google Analytics to refine strategies aligns perfectly with your requirements. I am eager to bring my expertise in performance marketing and content strategy to Aqarmap, contributing to your continued success in the Egyptian real estate market.

screening.q: Do you have 6+ years of experience in Marketing with strong Digital Marketing experience?
screening.a: Yes, I have over 6 years of experience specializing in digital marketing, growth, and performance optimization.

screening.q: Do you have 3+ years of experience in a managerial or team-lead role?
screening.a: Yes, I have 3+ years of experience leading performance marketing, content, and design teams.

screening.q: Do you have strong experience in Marketplace Management?
screening.a: Yes, I have extensive experience managing and optimizing marketplace performance for high-traffic platforms.

screening.q: Are you proficient in Google Analytics, Meta Ads, SEO, and Performance Marketing?
screening.a: Yes, I have strong proficiency in all these areas and regularly use them to drive data-driven marketing strategies.
